title: Technician - D. Open and fill an in-progress inspection
preconds: Logged in as Technician. Tech View. Per SV-8095 AC4, View Mode is NOT a gate for inspections. A line has an in-progress inspection (incl. on an approved line for Tech View roles).
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open an in-progress inspection on a line (click Open).
  3. Attempt to fill/edit the inspection items.
expected:
Step 2: The inspection opens.
Step 3: The Technician can fill/edit inspection items - even on an existing/approved line. Per SV-8095 AC4, inspection fill follows WOL Create and Edit only and is NOT gated by Tech View or line approval.
